papers.title: World in World: Explore the World with World Models
papers.abstract_snippet: Autoregressive video world models enable interactive, long-horizon exploration, but flexible control remains challenging. Exploring a source video from new viewpoints requires the generated rollout to remain synchronised with the recorded event, place observed content in the requested view, plausibly complete newly exposed regions, and recover previously generated appearance on revisits. Existing methods typically address these requirements through task-specific modules or additional training. W
papers.reason: 提出用自回归视频世界模型从新视角探索源视频，通过视角控制保持生成 rollout 与已记录事件的时序同步。属世界模型/交互式视频生成方向，摘要未见机器人操作或 VLA 策略实验证据，暂无明确复用路径，关注世界模型者可略读。
